entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Wasm debugging from VS Code ends at once when WasmEnableThreads is on, even with no threads started #137142
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: CompatibleWithTest_TypeLoadException on Apple mobile CoreCLR #137140
  • ILLink Roslyn analyzer: analysis time is quadratic in the number of lambdas in one method #137139
  • System.ComponentModel.Composition: CompositionLock.LockStateForRead/LockStateForWrite enter the lock before boxing its holder, so an OutOfMemoryException leaves the lock held #137138
  • Incorrect loop bound in SizeOptIListSelectIterator.ToList #137126
  • [wasm][mono][AOT] Record struct Equals in shared generic code asserts in mini_method_get_rgctx or traps with "function signature mismatch" #137123
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: System.Security.Cryptography.EcDiffieHellman.Tests.ECDiffieHellmanTests_OpenSsl.TestExplicitCurveImportO #137121
  • [mono][AOT] gsharedvt method calling INumberBase<T>.TryParse fails in aot-only mode #137120

Closed

  • Clarify in breaking-change rules and R2R that converting a struct to an enum is a breaking change #137055
  • JIT: (bug) recursive tail call to loop evaluates an arg setup after a parameter was already overwritten #134476
    12.0.0
  • Http3 tests failing with "An error occurred while sending the request." #136162
    Future
